Long-term? Saturn in Pisces, conjunct Neptune, asks whether you can build boundaries without dissolving.

Love prediction: a 5th-house romance gets intense but unstable. Career and money: Saturn conjunct Neptune in the 10th will shake shared finances.

Secret tip: Gemini must stop intellectualizing feelings, and Pisces must stop escaping into fantasy. Comment your partner’s sign!
